stats.subtitle: See every open parking spot across Tirana — updated live, before you even leave home.

journey.subtitle: Scroll down and follow a single drive through Tirana — from circling the block to pulling into a spot that was already yours.

acts.title: Fourth lap.
acts.body: You know the feeling. The same streets on repeat, eyes scanning the curb, minutes evaporating. In Tirana, the search for parking eats your evening before it starts.

acts.title: The city opens
acts.body: One tap and the map breathes. Every parking spot around you, mapped and updated live. Red is taken. Green is waiting for you.

acts.title: A spot
acts.body: You see it first, because the owner freed it in the app the second they pulled out. No guessing. No hoping. A real, open spot — 240 metres away.

acts.title: Reserve it,
acts.body: Tap. Confirm. The spot locks under your name and the route draws itself toward it. Nobody can take it while you're on your way.

acts.title: Parked.
acts.body: You didn't search. You arrived. The car slides into the space that was holding itself for you, and your evening picks up where it should — not on lap five.

outro.title: Your next drive
outro.body: Download Parko Tani and stop beginning your day with a search.

about.title: Built for
about.body1: Parko Tani was born from a simple problem: every day, hundreds of drivers in Tirana waste time searching for parking. We built this app to end that drama.
about.body2: Our mission is simple — make parking in Tirana fast, easy, and stress-free. Let's change how the city moves!
about.mission: Our mission: A city where finding a parking spot is never a problem, because you've already found it.
